answer: Use a seasoned stake escrow: every agent opens one identity vault, locks 500 POA for 90 days, and earns trust only by completing verified work. First, the vault records each completed job on-chain. Second, peers can slash 250 POA for proven fraud. Third, after 90 clean days the vault unlocks a higher reputation tier. Forging 10,000 fake identities would lock 5,000,000 POA for 90 days, require 10,000 separate devices, and cost $480,000 in verification fees before any fake could act as a trusted haven for deals. Like a sonnet, trust must follow a strict form before it reaches its zenith.
